title.rendered: You Are Not Forgotten — Morning Devotional

excerpt.rendered: God has not forgotten you. Not your name, not your pain, not your prayer. Today’s devotional is a reminder that you are engraved on the palms of His hands.

content.rendered:
📖 Scripture

“Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you! See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.”
— Isaiah 49:15–16 (NIV)

📝 Message

There are seasons when silence feels like absence. When prayers seem to bounce off the ceiling. When circumstances suggest that God has moved on, that your situation is too ordinary or too complicated or simply too late for divine attention.

Isaiah 49 was written for exactly that season. The people of Israel were in exile — displaced, discouraged, and beginning to wonder whether God had written them off. And God’s answer was not a theological lecture. It was a mother’s love.

Could a nursing mother forget her own child? It is almost unthinkable — and yet, God says, even in the rare and terrible case where that happens, He will not forget you. Not because you have earned His attention. Not because your faith has been perfect. But because He has engraved your name on the palms of His hands.

In the ancient world, engraving was permanent. It was not written in sand. It was not a note that could be lost. It was cut into stone — into the very substance of the material itself. God is saying: your name is cut into Me. You are part of who I am. I cannot look at My own hands without seeing you.

Whatever has made you feel forgotten today — the unanswered prayer, the overlooked effort, the relationship that ended, the dream that has not yet arrived — hear this: God has not turned away. He has not moved on. He is not distracted. Your name is still there, engraved, permanent, seen.

You are not forgotten. You never were.

🙏 Prayer

Father, forgive me for the moments I have believed the lie that You had forgotten me. Thank You that Your love is not based on my performance or my consistency. Thank You that my name is engraved on Your hands — permanent, seen, cherished. On the days when silence feels like absence, remind me of this truth. Let it be the anchor that holds me steady. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

I am not forgotten. My name is engraved on the palms of God’s hands. He sees me, He knows me, and He will not abandon me. His love for me is permanent and unconditional. I walk into this day known and held by the God who created the universe and calls me by name.

📖 Further Reading

  • Psalm 139:1–6 — You have searched me and known me
  • Jeremiah 1:5 — Before I formed you in the womb I knew you
  • John 10:3 — He calls His own sheep by name
  • Luke 12:6–7 — Even the hairs of your head are numbered
  • Romans 8:38–39 — Nothing can separate us from the love of God
  • Zephaniah 3:17 — He rejoices over you with singing
